---- MODULE W4Od19m1p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Branches == {"b1", "b2"}
TotalBooks == 2
Cap == 2

VARIABLES token, pool, reserved, transit, slow

vars == <<token, pool, reserved, transit, slow>>

Succ(b) == IF b = "b1" THEN "b2" ELSE "b1"

Total ==
    pool["b1"] + pool["b2"]
      + reserved["b1"] + reserved["b2"]
      + transit["b1"] + transit["b2"]

TypeOK ==
    /\ token \in Branches
    /\ pool \in [Branches -> 0..Cap]
    /\ reserved \in [Branches -> 0..Cap]
    /\ transit \in [Branches -> 0..Cap]
    /\ slow \in SUBSET Branches

Init ==
    /\ token = "b1"
    /\ pool = [b \in Branches |-> IF b = "b1" THEN TotalBooks ELSE 0]
    /\ reserved = [b \in Branches |-> 0]
    /\ transit = [b \in Branches |-> 0]
    /\ slow = {}

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<pool, reserved, transit, slow>>

Reserve(b) ==
    /\ token = b
    /\ b \notin slow
    /\ pool[b] > 0
    /\ pool' = [pool EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1]
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, transit, slow>>

Release(b) ==
    /\ token = b
    /\ b \notin slow
    /\ reserved[b] > 0
    /\ reserved' = [reserved EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1]
    /\ pool' = [pool EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, transit, slow>>

Ship(b) ==
    /\ token = b
    /\ pool[b] > 0
    /\ transit[Succ(b)] < Cap
    /\ pool' = [pool EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1]
    /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![Succ(b)] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, reserved, slow>>

Receive(b) ==
    /\ transit[b] > 0
    /\ pool[b] < Cap
    /\ transit' = [transit EXCEPT ![b] = @ - 1]
    /\ pool' = [pool EXCEPT ![b] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, reserved, slow>>

MarkSlow(b) ==
    /\ b \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, reserved, transit>>

ClearSlow(b) ==
    /\ b \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, pool, reserved, transit>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Reserve(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Release(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Ship(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : Receive(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : MarkSlow(b)
    \/ \E b \in Branches : ClearSlow(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conserve == Total = TotalBooks

====
nl:
A regional library reservation system spans several branches connected in a ring. A single token circulates the ring; only the branch currently holding the token may act on its local stock. A branch that holds the token can reserve a book (moving one copy from its available pool to its reserved shelf), release a reservation (moving it back to the pool), or ship a book to the next branch in the ring (the book leaves the pool and travels in transit). Any branch may receive an in-transit book into its pool. The token is always passed onward around the ring. A branch may be marked slow and later cleared; while slow it cannot reserve or release, but the token still passes it and it can still receive shipments. No book is ever created or destroyed as it moves between pools, reserved shelves, and transit.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of books across all pools, reserved shelves, and in-transit is always exactly the fixed initial total.

---- MODULE W4Od17m6p1t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Routers == {"r1", "r2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxT == 3
LeaseLen == 2
Cap == 4

VARIABLES clock, lease, record, buf, commits, slow

vars == <<clock, lease, record, buf, commits, slow>>

Valid(r) == lease.holder = r /\ clock < lease.expiry

TypeOK ==
    /\ clock \in 0..MaxT
    /\ lease \in [holder : Routers \cup {NONE}, expiry : 0..(MaxT + LeaseLen)]
    /\ record \in [val : 0..Cap, ver : 0..Cap]
    /\ buf \in [Routers -> [present : BOOLEAN, base : 0..Cap, val : 0..Cap]]
    /\ commits \in 0..Cap
    /\ slow \in SUBSET Routers

Init ==
    /\ clock = 0
    /\ lease = [holder |-> NONE, expiry |-> 0]
    /\ record = [val |-> 0, ver |-> 0]
    /\ buf = [r \in Routers |-> [present |-> FALSE, base |-> 0, val |-> 0]]
    /\ commits = 0
    /\ slow = {}

Tick ==
    /\ clock < MaxT
    /\ clock' = clock + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lease, record, buf, commits, slow>>

Acquire(r) ==
    /\ lease.holder = NONE \/ clock >= lease.expiry
    /\ lease' = [holder |-> r, expiry |-> clock + LeaseLen]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, record, buf, commits, slow>>

Read(r) ==
    /\ Valid(r)
    /\ r \notin slow
    /\ buf[r].present = FALSE
    /\ buf' = [buf EXCEPT ![r] = [present |-> TRUE, base |-> record.ver, val |-> record.val]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, record, commits, slow>>

Write(r) ==
    /\ Valid(r)
    /\ buf[r].present = TRUE
    /\ buf[r].base = record.ver
    /\ record.val < Cap
    /\ record' = [val |-> buf[r].val + 1, ver |-> record.ver + 1]
    /\ commits' = commits + 1
    /\ buf' = [buf EXCEPT ![r] = [present |-> FALSE, base |-> 0, val |-> 0]]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, slow>>

MarkSlow(r) ==
    /\ r \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, record, buf, commits>>

ClearSlow(r) ==
    /\ r \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {r}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, lease, record, buf, commits>>

Next ==
    \/ Tick
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Acquire(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Read(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : Write(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : MarkSlow(r)
    \/ \E r \in Routers : ClearSlow(r)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate == record.val = commits

====
nl:
An airport baggage router coordinates several routing agents that update a single shared bag-routing record. Ownership of the record is governed by a lease: an agent acquires a lease that expires at a future clock tick, and only the holder of a currently-valid lease may act. A global clock ticks forward, which can cause leases to expire so another agent may acquire the record. A lease holder first reads the record, buffering the value and its version, and later commits a write that increments the value, but only if the record's version still matches what it read; otherwise it must re-read. A committed write bumps the version and counts as one applied update. An agent may be marked slow and later cleared; while slow it delays reading (it does not fail), though its clock and lease still advance normally. Every applied update is preserved: none is silently overwritten by a stale writer.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The record's value always equals the number of committed updates, so no update is ever lost to a stale overwrite.

---- MODULE W4Od8m4p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences, FiniteSets

Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
Students == {"a", "b"}
Slots == {"s1", "s2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxQ == 2

VARIABLES q, cur, grants, freeSlots, rejected

vars == <<q, cur, grants, freeSlots, rejected>>

Queued(s) == \E i \in Instances : \E k \in 1..Len(q[i]) : q[i][k] = s
Serving(s) == \E i \in Instances : cur[i] = s
Granted(s) == \E g \in grants : g.student = s
Known(s)   == Queued(s) \/ Serving(s) \/ Granted(s) \/ s \in rejected

TypeOK ==
    /\ q \in [Instances -> Seq(Students)]
    /\ cur \in [Instances -> Students \cup {NONE}]
    /\ grants \in SUBSET [slot : Slots, student : Students]
    /\ freeSlots \in SUBSET Slots
    /\ rejected \in SUBSET Students

Init ==
    /\ q = [i \in Instances |-> <<>>]
    /\ cur = [i \in Instances |-> NONE]
    /\ grants = {}
    /\ freeSlots = Slots
    /\ rejected = {}

Submit(i, s) ==
    /\ Len(q[i]) < MaxQ
    /\ ~ Known(s)
    /\ q' = [q EXCEPT ![i] = Append(@, s)]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<cur, grants, freeSlots, rejected>>

Reject(i, s) ==
    /\ Len(q[i]) = MaxQ
    /\ ~ Known(s)
    /\ rejected' = rejected \cup {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<q, cur, grants, freeSlots>>

Take(i) ==
    /\ cur[i] = NONE
    /\ Len(q[i]) > 0
    /\ cur' = [cur EXCEPT ![i] = Head(q[i])]
    /\ q' = [q EXCEPT ![i] = Tail(q[i])]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grants, freeSlots, rejected>>

Allocate(i, sl) ==
    /\ cur[i] # NONE
    /\ sl \in freeSlots
    /\ grants' = grants \cup {[slot |-> sl, student |-> cur[i]]}
    /\ freeSlots' = freeSlots \ {sl}
    /\ cur' = [cur EXCEPT ![i] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<q, rejected>>

Reclaim(g) ==
    /\ g \in grants
    /\ grants' = grants \ {g}
    /\ freeSlots' = freeSlots \cup {g.slot}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<q, cur, rejected>>

Clear(s) ==
    /\ s \in rejected
    /\ rejected' = rejected \ {s}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<q, cur, grants, freeSlots>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Students : Submit(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, s \in Students : Reject(i, s)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Take(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances, sl \in Slots : Allocate(i, sl)
    \/ \E g \in grants : Reclaim(g)
    \/ \E s \in rejected : Clear(s)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

SeatConservation ==
    Cardinality(freeSlots) + Cardinality(grants) = Cardinality(Slots)

====
nl:
A university course-registration service runs two independent registrar instances that share one common pool of seats (slots). Each instance maintains its own bounded work queue of enrollment requests. A student's request is enqueued at an instance only if that instance's queue has room; if the queue is already full, backpressure kicks in and the request is rejected outright rather than queued. A rejected student may later be cleared and allowed to try again. Each instance takes the request at the head of its queue into service, then allocates one currently-free seat from the shared pool to that student, removing the seat from the pool. A student may reclaim (drop) their seat, returning it to the shared pool. Because both instances draw from the same pool, the allocation step must never hand the same seat to two different requests.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No seat is ever recorded as allocated to two different students.

---- MODULE W4Od6m4p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Cars == {"c1", "c2"}
Floors == {"f1", "f2"}
Total == 2
MaxWait == 2
CarCap == 2

VARIABLES source, waiting, inCar, delivered, carFloor, slow

vars == <<source, waiting, inCar, delivered, carFloor, slow>>

SumWait == waiting["f1"] + waiting["f2"]
SumCar == inCar["c1"] + inCar["c2"]

TypeOK ==
    /\ source \in 0..Total
    /\ waiting \in [Floors -> 0..MaxWait]
    /\ inCar \in [Cars -> 0..CarCap]
    /\ delivered \in 0..Total
    /\ carFloor \in [Cars -> Floors]
    /\ slow \in SUBSET Cars

Init ==
    /\ source = Total
    /\ waiting = [f \in Floors |-> 0]
    /\ inCar = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
    /\ delivered = 0
    /\ carFloor = [c \in Cars |-> "f1"]
    /\ slow = {}

Arrive(f) ==
    /\ source > 0
    /\ waiting[f] < MaxWait
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![f] = @ + 1]
    /\ source' = source - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<inCar, delivered, carFloor, slow>>

Board(c, f) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ carFloor[c] = f
    /\ waiting[f] > 0
    /\ inCar[c] < CarCap
    /\ waiting' = [waiting EXCEPT ![f] = @ - 1]
    /\ inCar' = [inCar EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, delivered, carFloor, slow>>

Deliver(c) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ inCar[c] > 0
    /\ inCar' = [inCar EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ delivered' = delivered + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, waiting, carFloor, slow>>

Move(c, f) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ carFloor[c] # f
    /\ carFloor' = [carFloor EXCEPT ![c] = f]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, waiting, inCar, delivered, slow>>

MarkSlow(c) ==
    /\ c \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, waiting, inCar, delivered, carFloor>>

ClearSlow(c) ==
    /\ c \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {c}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, waiting, inCar, delivered, carFloor>>

Next ==
    \/ \E f \in Floors : Arrive(f)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : Board(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : Deliver(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars, f \in Floors : Move(c, f)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : MarkSlow(c)
    \/ \E c \in Cars : ClearSlow(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

PassengerConservation ==
    source + SumWait + SumCar + delivered = Total

====
nl:
An elevator bank in a skyscraper serves passengers with two cars across several floors. Passengers originate from a fixed initial population. A hall call brings a waiting passenger onto a floor, but each floor's waiting area is bounded: when it is already full, backpressure prevents any further arrivals there until it drains. A car located at a floor may board one waiting passenger if it has room, may move between floors, and may deliver a passenger it is carrying (the passenger leaves the system as delivered). A car may be marked slow and later cleared; while slow it cannot board, deliver, or move, but it does not fail and its passengers remain aboard. Passengers are never created out of thin air nor destroyed: every passenger is always either not-yet-arrived, waiting, aboard a car, or delivered.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The number of not-yet-arrived, waiting, in-car, and delivered passengers always sums to the fixed initial population.

---- MODULE W4Od11m8p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Workers == {"w1", "w2"}
Printers == {"p1", "p2"}
NONE == "none"
MaxEpoch == 2

VARIABLES coarse, fine, epoch, grant, done

vars == <<coarse, fine, epoch, grant, done>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ coarse \in Workers \cup {NONE}
    /\ fine \in [Printers -> Workers \cup {NONE}]
    /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
    /\ grant \in [Workers -> 0..MaxEpoch]
    /\ done \in SUBSET [printer : Printers, worker : Workers, ep : 0..MaxEpoch]

Init ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ fine = [p \in Printers |-> NONE]
    /\ epoch = 0
    /\ grant = [w \in Workers |-> 0]
    /\ done = {}

AcquireCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarse = NONE
    /\ coarse' = w
    /\ grant' = [grant EXCEPT ![w] = epoch]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, epoch, done>>

AcquireFine(w, p) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ grant[w] = epoch
    /\ fine[p] = NONE
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![p] = w]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, epoch, grant, done>>

Print(w, p) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ fine[p] = w
    /\ grant[w] = epoch
    /\ done' = done \cup {[printer |-> p, worker |-> w, ep |-> epoch]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, fine, epoch, grant>>

ReleaseFine(w, p) ==
    /\ fine[p] = w
    /\ fine' = [fine EXCEPT ![p] = NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<coarse, epoch, grant, done>>

ReleaseCoarse(w) ==
    /\ coarse = w
    /\ \A p \in Printers : fine[p] # w
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fine, epoch, grant, done>>

Revoke ==
    /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
    /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
    /\ coarse' = NONE
    /\ fine' = [p \in Printers |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<grant, done>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : AcquireCoarse(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : AcquireFine(w, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : Print(w, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers, p \in Printers : ReleaseFine(w, p)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : ReleaseCoarse(w)
    \/ Revoke

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

HierLockDiscipline ==
    \A p \in Printers : fine[p] # NONE => fine[p] = coarse

====
nl:
A print shop job spooler runs two independent scheduler instances that share one pool of physical printers. Locking is hierarchical: a worker must first take the coarse group lock, then take a fine per-printer lock, before it may print. Acquiring a fine lock on a printer requires already holding the coarse lock under the current configuration epoch, and printing requires holding both locks with a grant stamped at the current epoch. A worker releases its fine locks and then the coarse lock when finished. The shop can revoke the configuration by bumping the epoch, which clears the coarse lock and all fine locks at once; any worker whose grant predates the new epoch is stale and must re-acquire. No unauthorized or stale worker may hold a printer without also being the current holder of the coarse group lock.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever a worker holds a fine lock on a printer, that same worker currently holds the coarse group lock.

---- MODULE W4Od12m4p4t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers, Sequences

Types == {"A", "B"}
Techs == {"t1", "t2"}
Cap == 3
MaxQ == 2
Donors == 4

VARIABLES source, queue, fridge, issued, slow

vars == <<source, queue, fridge, issued, slow>>

Stored == fridge["A"] + fridge["B"]

TypeOK ==
    /\ source \in 0..Donors
    /\ queue \in Seq(Types)
    /\ fridge \in [Types -> 0..Cap]
    /\ issued \in 0..(Donors + Cap)
    /\ slow \in SUBSET Techs

Init ==
    /\ source = Donors
    /\ queue = <<>>
    /\ fridge = [t \in Types |-> 0]
    /\ issued = 0
    /\ slow = {}

Donate(t) ==
    /\ source > 0
    /\ Len(queue) < MaxQ
    /\ queue' = Append(queue, t)
    /\ source' = source - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<fridge, issued, slow>>

Store(tech) ==
    /\ tech \notin slow
    /\ Len(queue) > 0
    /\ Stored < Cap
    /\ fridge' = [fridge EXCEPT ![Head(queue)] = @ + 1]
    /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, issued, slow>>

Issue(t) ==
    /\ fridge[t] > 0
    /\ fridge' = [fridge EXCEPT ![t] = @ - 1]
    /\ issued' = issued + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, queue, slow>>

MarkSlow(tech) ==
    /\ tech \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {tech}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, queue, fridge, issued>>

ClearSlow(tech) ==
    /\ tech \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {tech}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<source, queue, fridge, issued>>

Next ==
    \/ \E t \in Types : Donate(t)
    \/ \E tech \in Techs : Store(tech)
    \/ \E t \in Types : Issue(t)
    \/ \E tech \in Techs : MarkSlow(tech)
    \/ \E tech \in Techs : ClearSlow(tech)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

CapacityRespected == Stored <= Cap

====
nl:
A blood-bank inventory tracker receives donations from a fixed pool of donors and stores processed units in a shared refrigerator of limited total capacity. Donations arrive into a bounded intake queue; when that queue is full, backpressure blocks further donations until a technician drains it. A technician processes the unit at the head of the intake queue and stores it in the refrigerator, but only while the refrigerator's total holdings are below its capacity. Stored units may later be issued out to hospitals, decrementing the stored count. A technician may be marked slow and later cleared; while slow it cannot store units (it does not fail, and the intake queue simply waits). The refrigerator's total holdings must never exceed its fixed capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of units stored in the refrigerator never exceeds its capacity.

---- MODULE W4Od5m3p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets

Nodes == {"n1", "n2", "n3"}
NONE == "none"
MaxTerm == 2
Quorum == 2

VARIABLES term, leader, leaderTerm, alive, votedTerm, votedFor

vars == <<term, leader, leaderTerm, alive, votedTerm, votedFor>>

TypeOK ==
    /\ term \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {NONE}
    /\ leaderTerm \in 0..MaxTerm
    /\ alive \in SUBSET Nodes
    /\ votedTerm \in [Nodes -> 0..MaxTerm]
    /\ votedFor \in [Nodes -> Nodes \cup {NONE}]

Init ==
    /\ term = 0
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ leaderTerm = 0
    /\ alive = Nodes
    /\ votedTerm = [n \in Nodes |-> 0]
    /\ votedFor = [n \in Nodes |-> NONE]

Crash(n) ==
    /\ n \in alive
    /\ alive' = alive \ {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, leaderTerm, votedTerm, votedFor>>

Recover(n) ==
    /\ n \notin alive
    /\ alive' = alive \cup {n}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, leaderTerm, votedTerm, votedFor>>

StartElection ==
    /\ term < MaxTerm
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ leader' = NONE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leaderTerm, alive, votedTerm, votedFor>>

Vote(n, cand) ==
    /\ n \in alive
    /\ cand \in alive
    /\ votedTerm[n] < term
    /\ votedTerm' = [votedTerm EXCEPT ![n] = term]
    /\ votedFor' = [votedFor EXCEPT ![n] = cand]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, leader, leaderTerm, alive>>

Elect(cand) ==
    /\ leader = NONE
    /\ cand \in alive
    /\ Cardinality({n \in Nodes : votedTerm[n] = term /\ votedFor[n] = cand}) >= Quorum
    /\ leader' = cand
    /\ leaderTerm' = term
    /\ UNCHANGED <<term, alive, votedTerm, votedFor>>

Next ==
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Crash(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Recover(n)
    \/ StartElection
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, cand \in Nodes : Vote(n, cand)
    \/ \E cand \in Nodes : Elect(cand)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoStaleLeader == leader # NONE => leaderTerm = term

====
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker is coordinated by one elected leader among several server nodes. The leader is chosen by term-based election with failover: a new election bumps the term and clears the current leader, nodes vote at most once per term for a candidate, and a candidate becomes leader only after collecting a quorum of votes at the current term, recording the term at which it won. Any node can crash silently, dropping out of the live set without notice, and a crashed node can later recover and rejoin. When the current leader is suspected lost, a new election starts at a higher term. Only a leader whose winning term equals the current term is authorized to act; a stale leader from an older term must never remain the acting leader.
SAFETY PROPERTY: Whenever there is a current leader, the term it was elected in equals the current term.

---- MODULE W4Od3m1p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Banks == {"a", "b", "c"}
NONE == "none"
Total == 2
BCap == 3

Succ(x) == CASE x = "a" -> "b" [] x = "b" -> "c" [] OTHER -> "a"

VARIABLES balance, token, pending, escrow, slow

vars == <<balance, token, pending, escrow, slow>>

SumBal == balance["a"] + balance["b"] + balance["c"]

TypeOK ==
    /\ balance \in [Banks -> 0..BCap]
    /\ token \in Banks
    /\ pending \in [from : Banks \cup {NONE}, to : Banks \cup {NONE}]
    /\ escrow \in 0..Total
    /\ slow \in SUBSET Banks

Init ==
    /\ balance = [b \in Banks |-> IF b = "a" THEN 1 ELSE IF b = "b" THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ token = "a"
    /\ pending = [from |-> NONE, to |-> NONE]
    /\ escrow = 0
    /\ slow = {}

PassToken ==
    /\ token' = Succ(token)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, pending, escrow, slow>>

Propose(from, to) ==
    /\ token = from
    /\ from \notin slow
    /\ from # to
    /\ pending.from = NONE
    /\ balance[from] > 0
    /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![from] = @ - 1]
    /\ escrow' = escrow + 1
    /\ pending' = [from |-> from, to |-> to]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, slow>>

Commit ==
    /\ pending.from # NONE
    /\ pending.from \notin slow
    /\ balance[pending.to] < BCap
    /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![pending.to] = @ + 1]
    /\ escrow' = escrow - 1
    /\ pending' = [from |-> NONE, to |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, slow>>

Abort ==
    /\ pending.from # NONE
    /\ balance' = [balance EXCEPT ![pending.from] = @ + 1]
    /\ escrow' = escrow - 1
    /\ pending' = [from |-> NONE, to |-> NONE]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<token, slow>>

MarkSlow(b) ==
    /\ b \notin slow
    /\ slow' = slow \cup {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, token, pending, escrow>>

ClearSlow(b) ==
    /\ b \in slow
    /\ slow' = slow \ {b}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<balance, token, pending, escrow>>

Next ==
    \/ PassToken
    \/ \E from, to \in Banks : Propose(from, to)
    \/ Commit
    \/ Abort
    \/ \E b \in Banks : MarkSlow(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : ClearSlow(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MoneyConservation == SumBal + escrow = Total

====
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch clears transfers among member banks arranged in a ring. A single settlement token circulates the ring, and only the bank currently holding the token may initiate a transfer.
